strategy: Same authorized reviewed scopes and same execute_sql; shorter static SQL improves concrete review. No live writes by preparer.
source_guards: Four empty customer/site/meter/application roots locked; target locks prevent graph/trigger DDL races while selected UUIDs are pinned under count/hash guard. C technical writers remain enabled with compatible ROW EXCLUSIVE target lock.
preservation_guards: Nonselected UUID rowset hash includes every NULL/unknown classification. Exact actual FK children either must be empty or retain full-row fingerprints. Unexpected referencing child tables or DELETE triggers cause refusal. Foreign keys/triggers remain enabled.
d_freshness: Root rechecks explicit reviewed classification/count1 and archives any D-only volatile fingerprint update immediately before its paired transaction. No unrelated baseline refresh.
